source_note: All cases sourced from public OSHA.gov / DOL.gov press releases and eTools. Civilian shipyards only. No Navy mishap data included by design (see PASSDOWN.md, Section 7).

cases.shipyard: St. John's Ship Building, Palatka FL
cases.summary: Welder entered a 4x8 ft space in a ship's hull for fabrication work without the space being tested for oxygen content. Supervisor who went to assist was also overcome. Welder died of asphyxiation.
cases.root_cause: No pre-entry atmospheric testing for oxygen deficiency.
cases.osha_subpart: 1915 Subpart B - Confined and Enclosed Spaces

cases.shipyard: First Marine LLC, Calvert City KY
cases.summary: Explosion onboard a towboat during cutting/welding in an atmosphere containing flammable gases. 3 fatalities, 2 critical injuries. Five contractors cited (prime, insulation sub, two staffing agencies, one individual).
cases.root_cause: Hot work performed without testing for explosive atmosphere; confined space not tested before entry.
cases.osha_subpart: 1915 Subpart D - Welding, Cutting and Heating / Subpart B - Confined Spaces

cases.shipyard: Detyens Shipyards Inc., North Charleston SC
cases.summary: 41-year-old worker fell ~20 ft from an unguarded platform edge inside a gas tank aboard a Naval Ship undergoing fuel piping work. Co-workers were waiting for him to descend a ladder.
cases.root_cause: No guardrails on platform edge; inadequate lighting; no hard hats required for workers below overhead activity.
cases.osha_subpart: 1915 Subpart E - Guarding of Deck Openings and Edges

cases.shipyard: Detyens Shipyards Inc., North Charleston SC
cases.summary: Employee fatally struck by a shackle during a lifting operation while positioned between a guardrail and a rudder shaft being lifted.
cases.root_cause: No fall protection system in use; employee allowed in a caught-between hazard zone during a lift.

cases.shipyard: Detyens Shipyards Inc., North Charleston SC
cases.summary: Comprehensive OSHA inspection (Regional Emphasis Program on Maritime Industries) resulted in 1 repeated, 13 serious, 1 other-than-serious citation for fall, electrical, and amputation hazards.
cases.root_cause: Systemic/repeat noncompliance pattern at the same facility -- valuable as a longitudinal case rather than a single incident.

notes_for_next_pass: Need 5-10 cases per category; currently strongest in fall_protection (Detyens longitudinal) and confined_space.
Hot work has good regulatory/stat grounding but needs more discrete case examples beyond First Marine.
Working aloft and over-the-side need dedicated case pulls -- current data treats them as subcategories of fall_protection.
